0022600187.text: The Orlando Magic (2-5, 2-1 on the road, 12th in the East) visit the Phoenix Suns (1-5, 1-2 at home, 12th in the West) in a matchup of two teams on losing streaks, with Orlando on a two-game skid and Phoenix on four straight losses. Orlando is missing Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain, 24.5 points per game this season), Jalen Suggs (knee, 8.0 points per game this season), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), and Noah Penda (hamstring strain), while Phoenix is without Mark Williams (shoulder surgery) and has Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Rasheer Fleming (ankle sprain) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with the Magic winning the most recent meeting 115-111 in Orlando on March 31, 2026.
